players.product: whole-exome / whole-transcriptome molecular profiling (MI Profile tissue, Caris Assure blood), clinico-genomic database and AI models

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus supplier disclosure: in July 2024 Caris entered a master supply agreement with Roche Diagnostics Corporation for Roche to provide sequencing probes and other testing supplies and equipment for clinical and research uses in its laboratory operations. Caris receives certain pricing levels if it purchases a specified minimum annual quantity, and its rolling forecasts become three- and six-month binding purchase commitments for catalog and custom products; pricing was fixed for the initial 12 months and is subject to increase thereafter. Roche is also named among Caris's sole suppliers of certain lab materials, reagents and supplies.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: supplier (sequencing probes, testing supplies and equipment; master supply agreement July 2024)

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus supplier disclosure: Caris also relies on sole suppliers including Matsunami Glass USA and Agilent Technologies for certain lab materials, reagents and supplies, and on sole suppliers or manufacturers for blood collection tubes (including the cfDNA PAXgene tubes used for liquid biopsy profiling), total nucleic acid extraction kits, and the NGS panels and library preparation kits it uses; it has no written supply agreements with Agilent, Matsunami Glass and PAXgene and buys on a purchase-order basis. Its supply agreements with purchase commitments (mostly binding forecasts of 12 months or less) carried future minimum purchase commitments of $7.7 million, all due in 2025, and supplies purchased under such agreements in 2024 totalled $32.3 million.
quarterly_data.figure: future minimum purchase commitments $7.7M (all due 2025); $32.3M of supplies purchased under supply agreements in 2024
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: sole suppliers of lab materials, reagents and supplies (purchase-order basis, no written supply agreement)

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus: in 2022 Caris entered an arrangement for cloud computing services with non-cancellable purchase commitments for three years, amended in 2024 (this passage does not name the provider). It purchased cloud computing services of $9.9 million in 2024 and $3.0 million in 2023 under non-cancelable arrangements, and has purchase obligations of $11.3 million, $12.4 million and $13.7 million for the years ending December 31, 2025, 2026 and 2027.

Prospectus: Caris's molecular profiling solutions and multi-omic data serve more than 100 biopharma partners, such as Moderna, AbbVie, Xencor and Merck KGaA, through prospective and retrospective profiling services, companion diagnostics development, data licensing and commercial services that include identifying patients for approved therapies. Caris Discovery, launched in 2022, has strategic partnerships with Merck KGaA and Xencor to develop therapeutics against novel targets that emanate from Caris's molecular insights; the discovery proteomics and target-validation work is performed by over 50 Caris scientists in its 59,000 square foot R&D laboratory in Tempe, Arizona.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 100 biopharma partners; over 50 scientists; 59,000 square foot Tempe R&D laboratory
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: biopharma partners (Merck KGaA and Xencor also Caris Discovery therapeutics partners)

players.product: NovaSeq sequencing, BioInsight, and Billion Cell Atlas multi-omics data

connects_to.relationship: sole supplier of NGS sequencing instruments, sequencing reagent kits and instrument maintenance

contracts.signal: Prospectus supplier disclosure: Caris relies on Illumina as the sole supplier of NGS instruments and the associated sequencing reagent kits for its solutions, and Illumina is also the sole provider of maintenance and repair services for these instruments. In November 2022 Caris entered Illumina's 'open offer' supply agreement, under which Illumina provides certain sequencers, equipment and other materials for research and clinical activities; it has no minimum purchase requirements but provides volume discounts and other promotions, is irrevocable by Illumina until its expiration in August 2033, and Caris may terminate it at any time on 90 days' prior written notice.
contracts.units: sole supplier of NGS instruments and sequencing reagent kits

connects_to.relationship: AWS cloud hosting and data analysis

contracts.signal: Prospectus supplier disclosure: Caris hosts its data on, and conducts certain data analysis through, Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud-based hosting facilities as well as its own co-located or on-premise computing infrastructure, and lists an interruption of AWS services among the risks to processing its data, developing solutions or providing test results.
